coding.display: Endodontic therapy, molar tooth (excluding final restoration)

note.text: Single-visit root canal therapy (CDT D3330), tooth #19: three canals instrumented and obturated; patient tolerated the procedure well. Final restoration (crown) to be placed by the patient's regular dental provider (see the post-treatment CarePlan at Interaction 4). Tooth designation uses the ADA Universal Numbering System (#19); the source document's 'FDI 36' label is the separately-flagged FDI error and is deliberately NOT reproduced here, per ADA confirmation that FDI is not used for US dental data.
